justification: Inspected `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/encode/MECARDContactEncoder.java` (lines 79-84) and `android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/encode/ContactEncoder.java` (lines 99-102). `MECARDTelDisplayFormatter` is a private static nested helper with one constant and one method; it only formats TEL display text by calling `ContactEncoder.formatPhone(...)` and stripping non-digit/plus characters. It has a single, narrow responsibility and no evidence of low cohesion, excessive size, or multiple separable concerns.
